verses.text: Then the angel who was talking with me came back and woke me up, like someone being woken from sleep.
He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a lampstand made of solid gold, with a bowl on top of it. There are seven lamps on it, with seven pipes leading to the lamps on top.
There are also two olive trees beside it, one on the right side of the bowl and one on the left."
I asked the angel who was talking with me, "What are these, my lord?"
The angel who was talking with me answered, "Don't you know what these are?" I said, "No, my lord."
So he said to me, "This is the LORD's message to Zerubbabel: 'Not by strength and not by power, but by my Spirit,' says the LORD of Armies.
What are you, mighty mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become flat ground. Then he will bring out the top stone of the temple while people shout, 'God bless it! God bless it!'"
Then the LORD gave me this message:
"The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this temple, and his hands will also finish it. Then you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.

Who dares to look down on this day of small beginnings? People will rejoice when they see the plumb line in Zerubbabel's hand. These seven lamps are the eyes of the LORD, which look all around the whole earth."
Then I asked the angel, "What are these two olive trees on the right and the left of the lampstand?"
I asked him again, "What are these two olive branches beside the two gold pipes that pour out golden oil?"
He answered, "Don't you know what these are?" I said, "No, my lord."
So he said, "These are the two who have been anointed to serve the Lord of the whole earth."
